events.name: Fireside Chat with Tanay Kothari, Wispr Flow
events.description:
South Park Commons is excited to host Tanay Kothari, co-founder & CEO of Wispr (and SPC alum) for a fireside chat.
Event Details
3:00pm: Doors Open
3:30-4:30pm: Fireside Chat
Tanay Kothari is the co-founder and CEO of Wispr and Wispr Advanced Interfaces Lab. A four-time founder, he launched FeatherX, an AI personalization startup for online stores, while still in college. After it was acquired by Cerebra Technologies, he joined the company to lead engineering and product. Earlier, he built Convert, a music discovery platform that grew to more than 2.5 million organic monthly active users.

Tanay holds a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and a master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence from Stanford, where he taught the university’s Deep Learning course alongside Prof. Andrew Ng and published research at the Stanford AI Lab. He also served as President of the Stanford Venture Capital Club for three years. In 2023, he was named to the Forbes 30 Under 30 list.

About South Park Commons (SPC)
SPC is a technical community and venture fund dedicated to helping founders, researchers, and technologists figure out what to work on next—what we call the -1 to 0 stage of your career. We believe this is best accomplished in the most talent-dense community possible.
SPC events are open to members, alumni, and special guests of the community. The best way to join events at SPC is to apply for SPC membership.

events.name: Fireside Chat with Abhinav Gupta, Skild.ai
events.description:
South Park Commons is delighted to host Abhinav Gupta, co-founder of Skild.ai.
Event Details
4:30pm: Doors Open
5:00-6:00pm: Fireside Chat

Abhinav Gupta serves as President and Co‑Founder of Skild AI. He is also a Professor at the Robotics Institute, Carnegie Mellon University. Prior to this, Abhinav was founding research lead at FAIR Robotics and worked at Google and AI2 as well.
At Skild, Abhinav focuses on building a general-purpose brain for robots with a long-term goal of building general purpose intelligence. Abhinav is known for pioneering contributions to AI, including scaling visual and robot learning, self-supervised learning, and lifelong learning systems.
He is a recipient of several awards including IAPR 2020 JK Aggarwal Prize, PAMI 2016 Young Researcher Award, ONR Young Investigator Award, Sloan Research Fellowship, Okawa Foundation Grant, Bosch Young Faculty Fellowship, YPO Fellowship, IJCAI Early Career Spotlight, ICRA Best Student Paper award, and the ECCV Best Paper Runner-up Award. His research has also been featured in Newsweek, BBC, Wall Street Journal, Wired and Slashdot.
